literal_meaning: কর্তা এবং বিধাতা (doer-controller and the disposer/creator)
figurative_meaning_en: The person with supreme authority in every respect
similar_in_english: The one who calls the shots
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই প্রতিষ্ঠানের হর্তাকর্তা বিধাতা কে তা সিদ্ধান্ত নেয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He is the lord and master of his household.
Who is the ultimate authority in this organization decides everything.
note: Refers to absolute control, often with divine connotations due to 'বিধাতা' implying a creator figure.
